description: Golden conformance vectors covering hash, mask (token and ip_prefix), drop, and Stage 2/3 redaction tokens across all 11 hole classes and field types (§5, §14).

vectors.description: hash transform computes keyed nested HMAC-SHA256 pseudonym token
lower + hash produces identical pseudonym tag for mixed-case email
hash transform with kind:phone tags E.164 phone number
hash transform without explicit kind uses field pii class as token kind
hash transform without kind on pii:none falls back to <hash:tag>
hash transform tag changes deterministically with project HMAC keys
hash transform leaves pre-existing pseudonym token unchanged (no double hashing, §14)
pre-existing mask token <card> short-circuits hash transform and stays redacted
mask mode:token kind:name yields redacted status with <name> marker
mask with omitted mode defaults to token mode
mask with omitted mode and kind yields <redacted> marker
mask mode:ip_prefix truncates IPv4 to /24 prefix
mask mode:ip_prefix zeroes last octet of 10.20.30.255
mask mode:ip_prefix masks 0.0.0.1 to 0.0.0.0/24
mask mode:ip_prefix truncates full IPv6 to canonical RFC 5952 /48
mask mode:ip_prefix truncates compressed IPv6 2001:db8::1 to 2001:db8::/48
mask mode:ip_prefix truncates ::1 to ::/48
mask mode:ip_prefix truncates fe80::1234:5678 to fe80::/48
mask mode:ip_prefix reports invalid_ip parse_error on non-IP word
pre-masked token <ip> short-circuits ip_prefix mask and remains redacted
drop transform discards secret text field value
drop transform discards free_text object field value
drop transform discards args field value
drop at end of transform chain yields dropped status
mask token <card> matches word hole and produces redacted marker (§5)
mask token <card> matches int hole and produces redacted marker (§5)
mask token <secret:jwt> matches float hole and produces redacted marker (§5)
mask token <secret:kv> matches uuid hole and produces redacted marker (§5)
mask token <secret:jwt> matches hex hole and produces redacted marker (§5)
mask token <card> matches ip hole and produces redacted marker (§5)
mask token <us_ssn> matches time hole and produces redacted marker (§5)
mask token <name> matches quoted hole and produces redacted marker (§5)
mask token <secret:kv> matches json hole and produces redacted marker (§5)

sql.reason: Specs containing a json hole cannot be compiled to ClickHouse RE2 extractGroups because RE2 cannot match balanced brackets (§5, T2.1.5).

vectors.description: mask token <card> matches until hole and produces redacted marker (§5)
mask token <secret:jwt> matches rest hole and produces redacted marker (§5)
pseudonym token matches word hole and is stored as value of string field (§5)
pseudonym token matches quoted hole and is stored as value of string field (§5)
pseudonym token matches uuid hole and is stored as value of string field (§5)
pseudonym token matches ip hole and is stored as value of string field (§5)
pseudonym token matches until hole and is stored as value of string field (§5)
pseudonym token matches rest hole and is stored as value of string field (§5)
pseudonym token in non-string (int) field is treated as a mask (§5)
pseudonym token in non-string (float) field is treated as a mask (§5)
pseudonym token in non-string (bool) field is treated as a mask (§5)
pseudonym token in non-string (timestamp) field is treated as a mask (§5)
pseudonym token in non-string (enum) field is treated as a mask (§5)
pseudonym token in non-string (json) field is treated as a mask (§5)

vectors.description: mask token in int hole short-circuits scale transform without parse_error
angle brackets containing whitespace are NOT a redaction token and fail int hole
empty angle brackets <> are NOT a redaction token and fail int hole
uppercase <CARD> is NOT a valid lowercase redaction token and fails int hole
